concerns.text: SC-003 requires 'At least 80% of top-100 features must be within ±10kb of TSS', but T007 computes the stat 'report-only, never exit non-zero on threshold miss'. This silently converts a spec success criterion into an advisory metric — a semantic weakening the deterministic FR-012 check cannot catch. Either amend the spec to reclassify SC-003 as report-only, or make the task enforce it.

Constitution Principle VI mandates 'total runtime per cell line must not exceed 2 hours' with profiling logs verifying compliance, but T005's verification only checks 'RAM < 7 GB and runtime < 6 h' (SC-005). The per-cell-line 2-hour bound is dropped from the task's verification step.

Spec §1.2 and US1 require data for '≥5 human cell lines', but T005's Sample Size Gate 'skips cell lines with N < 4' with no guaranteed minimum count of trained lines. Skipping can silently reduce below 5 without spec-level authorization; the task should state the minimum retained lines or the spec should authorize the narrowing.

T003 excludes 'TSS ± 2 kb promoter bins' from the FR-002 aggregation window. The circularity rationale (plan Principle VII) is sound, but spec FR-002 says 'within ±50kb of TSS' with no exclusion — the task narrows an FR without a spec amendment. Amend spec FR-002 to record the promoter exclusion.

T002 cites 'https://ftp.eensembl.org/' — a malformed/nonexistent host — as a canonical source alongside the correct ftp.ebi.ac.uk GENCODE mirror. Constitution Principle I requires the same canonical source every run; an ambiguous/malformed URL violates this. Remove the bad URL.

Constitution Principle III and the plan's Data Hygiene Gate require raw data checksummed and recorded in state/, and derived files carrying checksums/derivation logs. No task's deliverables or verification mention checksum recording for data/raw or data/processed artifacts — the hygiene gate has silently vanished from the task list.

Constitution Principle I requires random seeds pinned in code/; T005 (LOOCV, alpha grid) and T003 do not mention seed pinning in deliverables or verification. Add explicit seed pinning to the stochastic steps.

Constitution Principle VII requires biological interpretation 'documented in the interpretation/ directory'; T008 writes docs/regulatory_insights_report.md instead. Either amend the constitution path or write to interpretation/ — currently the task diverges from the constitution's stated location.
